This impressive 55-story structure will be the new global headquarters for American Express. Spanning nearly two million square feet, it’s projected to be fully operational by 2031, contributing billions to the economy and creating thousands of new jobs. This marks a pivotal milestone in the site's redevelopment after 25 years.

stories.title: 13-year-old coder’s water campaign reaches 1 million people, saves 20 million gallons
Delhi 2047: The big plan, the bigger question
Scientists fitted GPS collars to 17 lions and 14 hyenas expecting hyenas to follow lions
stories.summary: A groundbreaking study suggests that it's the male lions that approach spotted hyenas, contrary to the belief that hyenas seek out lion remains for food. In fact, spotted hyenas are known to back away from lions, prioritizing their safety. This finding highlights the importance of spatial avoidance in hyena behavior, emphasizing their adaptive strategies to circumvent confrontations with such powerful hunters.

stories.title: H-1B is officially dead, nobody will take the risk: Indian career coach says DHS proposal language on ending 60-day grace period is brutal
What happened to Doja Cat? Twitch livestream leaves fans deeply concerned
stories.summary: Doja Cat's latest Twitch livestream has left fans worried due to her lack of clarity and focus. The rapper shared feelings of exhaustion regarding her music career and interactions with fans, which raised eyebrows following her earlier admissions about battling alcohol and marijuana issues. However, she later took to social media to reassure her supporters that she was, in fact, doing well.

stories.title: Instead of managing billions, Warren Buffett’s son Howard Buffett chose farming
stories.summary: Choosing a path less traveled, Howard Buffett, the son of Warren Buffett, dedicated his life to farming and conservation rather than finance. He skillfully managed farms in Nebraska and Illinois, prioritizing soil health. Warren Buffett supported his passion by purchasing a Nebraska farm for his son. As he transitions to the role of non-executive chairman at Berkshire Hathaway, Howard aims to safeguard the company’s culture following his father's legacy.

stories.title: US court rules 150,000 Mississippi residents have no constitutional right to lead-free water
stories.summary: A federal appeals court has determined that the US Constitution does not explicitly provide a right to clean drinking water. Residents of Jackson residents claimed their city was aware of unsafe water conditions but chose to mislead them. Although the court acknowledged the severity of these claims, it denied the establishment of a constitutional right to safe water and pointed to different legal recourses.

stories.title: Uttarakhand to launch month-long ‘Seva Sankalp’ campaign from Sept 17: CM Dhami
No vaccine-autism link, finds WHO review
After husband’s death, she ensured their 215 acres stay protected
stories.summary: Becky Shelton made a conscious decision to prioritize land preservation over lucrative offers from developers. By securing her properties in King George and Stafford with legal protections, she ensures these areas remain untouched for future custodians. Shelton views her role as a temporary steward of the earth, taking action to prevent the encroachment of subdivisions and data centers on the natural landscape.

stories.title: Evening news wrap: PM Modi, Putin & world leaders share stage at BRICS; Delhi man found with uterus, testes & more
A San Francisco house worth $4.4 million changed hands through disputed deeds in little over a year
stories.summary: In a dramatic legal move, San Francisco authorities have initiated a lawsuit to annul eight contentious deeds associated with a luxurious $4.4 million property in the prestigious Sea Cliff area. This case has been characterized by officials as a complex scheme aimed at seizing control of the estate. After over a year of dubious ownership transitions, the city aims to rectify property records and reaffirm the rightful ownership.

stories.title: Indian-origin taxi driver drove New Yorkers for free for 40 days after 9/11
PM Modi reiterates dialogue, diplomacy in talks with Putin; accepts Russia visit invite
stories.summary: Prime Minister Modi held crucial talks with Russian President Putin, highlighting dialogue and diplomacy as essential pathways forward. India has offered its aid in peace initiatives to mitigate the ongoing conflict in Ukraine. The leaders examined their cooperative efforts across trade, energy, defence, and space sectors, alongside deliberating on pressing regional and global matters of shared concern.

stories.title: In 2002, San Antonio gave an Air Force base for redevelopment; 24 years later, it is expanding
stories.summary: San Antonio’s Brooks Development Authority is expanding beyond the former 1,308-acre Air Force base it has redeveloped since 2002. It will take control of 243 vacant acres along Southton Road and prepare the site with roads and utilities. The move aims to attract major employers and extend development across the city’s Southeast Side.

stories.title: Montana seals 20 hazards at five abandoned uranium sites that once supplied US defence program
stories.summary: Several abandoned uranium mine sites in Montana’s Pryor Mountains have been closed after assessments found physical hazards, radiation and chemical contamination risks. The project addressed 20 mine features across five historic sites, while also protecting bat habitat, rare plants and cultural resources. Officials said continued monitoring will be needed because erosion, gravity and vandalism can affect mine closures over time.

stories.title: From 2017-19, Japan recycled 6.21M phones into 5,000 Tokyo Olympic and Paralympic medals
stories.summary: Japan embarked on a groundbreaking initiative ahead of the 2020 Olympic and Paralympic Games, gathering millions of used electronics and phones. This effort resulted in the extraction of significant gold, silver, and bronze from these devices by recyclers. The recovered metals were then transformed into the medals awarded at the events, reflecting a nationwide commitment to sustainability and innovative recycling practices involving local municipalities and businesses.

stories.title: JD(U) renaming on cards? Leaders back proposal to name party after Nitish
PM Modi, Putin share car ride again in Delhi, weeks after traveling together in Bishkek - watch
stories.summary: During an informal car ride in Delhi, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin rekindled their camaraderie, continuing their tradition of traveling together. This ride marks their fourth time sharing a vehicle, following earlier occasions in Bishkek and Tianjin. Their private talks during the journey underscore the depth of their diplomatic ties and mutual understanding.

stories.title: Building Brics: PM Modi-Putin talks, a Thirukkural gift and Xi's big return - key points
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met Russian President Vladimir Putin during the summit. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian also arrived for discussions with PM Modi. Chinese President Xi Jinping is expected for bilateral talks and the summit. The expanded Brics grouping focuses on development and cooperation among emerging economies. India hosts the summit under its theme of resilience and innovation.

stories.title: Uber exits Nigeria, Uganda: Why Africa's ride-hailing market is getting tougher
stories.summary: Uber has officially ended its operations in Nigeria and Uganda, marking a significant retreat from these markets. This decision comes as a result of escalating operating expenses and fierce competition, which have negatively impacted ride-hailing fares and driver earnings. Rising costs for fuel and vehicle upkeep weighed heavily on drivers' incomes. Despite this setback, Uber continues to prioritize other sub-Saharan African markets where growth seems promising.

stories.title: After losing 75% of wetlands, Niagara River uses recycled Christmas trees to restore fish habitat
stories.summary: In an innovative approach, conservation teams are utilizing recycled Christmas trees to rejuvenate the coastal wetlands of Niagara River. This dynamic initiative, launched in 2016, spans over 1.64 kilometers, serving to calm wave action and lower erosion rates. By restoring vital aquatic habitats, the project aims to enhance the ecosystem, leading to a remarkable increase in both fish and shorebird populations alongside improved water quality.

stories.title: Former AT&T worker accused of SIM-swap scheme targeting $600,000 from victims
In the 1950s, Hugo Meyer bought abandoned Vermont farms; his family has protected 18,000+ acres
stories.summary: In a remarkable effort, the Meyer family has preserved thousands of acres in the Worcester Range of Vermont, committing to a sustainable approach to timber management. This conservation initiative plays a vital role in protecting significant wildlife corridors and northern hardwood ecosystems, with part of the funding sourced from the U.S. Forest Service's Forest Legacy Program, paving the way for future generations to enjoy the area's natural beauty.

stories.title: Punjab sets two-week deadline to distribute 33 lakh Mukh Mantri Sehat Yojana cards
stories.summary: Punjab is set to roll out 33 lakh Mukh Mantri Sehat Yojana cards imminently. To facilitate this, dedicated camps will be established across 2,008 villages and wards, aiming for complete distribution within a week of launching. ASHA workers and facilitators are incentivized for efficiently delivering the cards, with any remaining ones being distributed door-to-door within two weeks of the camps.

stories.title: Indian man on student visa in US sentenced to 30 months for defrauding Vietnam veteran
Brics summit: PM Modi gifts Putin Russian translation of Thirukkural
stories.summary: During a significant meeting ahead of the BRICS Summit, Prime Minister Modi gifted President Putin a translated version of the ancient Tamil text, Thirukkural, by Naira Mkrtchyan. Both leaders held bilateral talks on the sidelines of the Brics summit being held in New Delhi.

stories.title: ‘Why is government silent?’ Congress targets BJP over US ‘Mr Singh’ ad
stories.summary: In a striking move, the Congress party has chastised the Indian government for its silence on a provocative from the US Department of Homeland Security. Featuring the phrase 'Mr Singh,' the ad was seen as an affront to Indian respect. Advocacy groups chimed in, condemning the message as racial profiling. Following significant backlash, the US Department of Homeland Security ultimately decided to withdraw the contentious .

stories.title: Cong vs Cong: Tharoor rebuffs Chidambaram's view on Brics, hails summit's 'diplomatic convening power'
Scientist finds 10,000-year-old mastodon molar while surveying California creek for threatened frogs
stories.summary: While investigating a creek for frogs, a scientist stumbled upon a remarkable ancient mastodon tooth, estimated to be over ten thousand years old. Paleontologists have confirmed its belonging to a long-extinct species of Pacific mastodon. The fossil will soon be analyzed at Stanford University to determine its precise age, establishing a fascinating connection between today's conservation initiatives and the ancient ecosystems of California.

stories.title: Hawaii’s 124-year-old red mangroves now threaten native waterbirds and waterways
NPCI Bharat Bill Pay proposes new infra to fix MSME's collection problems
stories.summary: The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) Bharat BillPay has introduced a pioneering digital platform that links invoices directly to payments. This innovative framework is designed to alleviate the credit bottlenecks that many MSMEs encounter. By digitizing the order-to-cash cycle with standardized APIs and automating reconciliation, the system transforms buyer-confirmed invoices into fundable records. This development aims to enhance MSME efficiency and promote growth within the formal sector.

stories.title: Full list of world leaders attending Brics summit in New Delhi
Wigs, makeup let fraudsters pose as NFL players, scoring $20M in fake loans
stories.summary: In a stunning twist, two individuals from Georgia devised a sophisticated scheme to impersonate professional football players for financial gain. They established fake companies and produced counterfeit documentation, even going as far as using disguises during video calls. Altogether, they amassed an astonishing $19.845 million through twelve fraudulent loans from various lenders before their plot was uncovered by a players' union that detected bogus contracts.

stories.title: Algorithms should be able to explain reasoning behind decisions to customers: RBI Murmu
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India mandates that lenders provide explanations for credit application rejections, emphasizing the need for transparent algorithms. This move ensures equitable access to financial resources. Moreover, institutions are urged to safeguard against potential threats posed by quantum computing. Rather than diminishing lender accountability, technology must amplify credit accessibility and empower customer choice, while regulated entities remain liable for all services offered under their banner.

stories.title: Malaysian students built a device that turns sink wastewater into electricity
FCRA Amendment Bill: JPC to begin scrutiny on September 18, Sanjay Jaiswal to chair panel
More than 1,000 volunteers built a four-bedroom house in 50 hours, launching 35-home community
stories.summary: Over one thousand volunteers constructed a four-bedroom house in just fifty hours. This remarkable effort provided a new home for single mother Yadira Salas and her children. Volunteers worked in shifts, contributing their labor and skills to the rapid construction. Salas also actively participated, investing her own "sweat equity" into the build. This accelerated project exemplifies Habitat for Humanity's commitment to affordable homeownership.

stories.title: Alliance Air plane makes emergency landing in Delhi after engine failure
A quarter century after 9/11: 25 ways America's darkest day changed the world
Dating to 1898, Nipomo's oldest church donated after 128 years to become a community hub
stories.summary: A historic church in Nipomo, California, dating to 1898, has been donated to the Dana Adobe and Cultural Center by its owners, John and Rebecca Prewett. The building will be developed into a museum, event venue and “Visit Nipomo” centre, while Calvary Church will continue holding Sunday services there.

stories.title: Belize Reef Restoration Effort: Lisa Carne revives storm-hit corals; project outplants 100,000 fragments
stories.summary: In 2001, Hurricane Iris wreaked havoc on Belize's coral reefs, sparking an innovative restoration effort. Marine biologist Lisa Carne took the lead in replanting coral fragments, which were often neglected. Through her organization, Fragments of Hope, more than 100,000 corals have been successfully restored, resulting in a remarkable boost in coral coverage and marine biodiversity.

stories.title: Las Vegas developers buy 940 acres of former federal desert for $94 million; 6,000-home community planned
stories.summary: A large federal desert parcel near Las Vegas will become Monument Hills, a new master-planned community. This development will feature up to 6,000 homes and various amenities for residents. The $94 million land deal is the largest BLM transaction in the valley for decades. Proceeds from the sale will fund projects across Nevada, including parks and education. First homes are anticipated to be available around spring 2028.

stories.title: PM Modi pays tribute to 9/11 victims, calls for firm stand against terror
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tribute to the victims of the 9/11 attacks, reiterating India’s strong stance against terrorism in all its forms. Recognizing India's own experiences with cross-border terrorism, he emphasized the nation’s leadership in the global fight against this menace. Reflecting on his visit to the 9/11 Memorial in 2014, he extended solidarity with international efforts to eradicate this global threat.

stories.title: Indonesia seeks to repatriate five baby orangutans found in Odisha; trafficking network suspected
Actor Max Thieriot bought a 90-acre ranch in 2013; his Sonoma Hollywood retreat is now a vineyard
stories.summary: Max Thieriot’s roughly 90-acre Sonoma County ranch has evolved since he and his wife Lexi bought it in 2013. The property now includes the nine-acre Bodega Thieriot Pinot noir vineyard, while the rest remains hillside, woodland and pasture. Though the actor’s family now lives in Washington state for most of the year, he continues returning to the ranch during the off-season.

stories.title: Snake grows a fake spider on its tail to lure birds; scans reveal surprisingly normal bones inside
stories.summary: Researchers utilized XCT scanning technology to investigate the unique tail of a viper. The imaging uncovered the presence of standard viper vertebrae within the tail's unusual form. This finding underscores the discrepancies that can exist between external appearance and internal skeletal makeup. Fossilized remains alone may not capture the true look of an organism, while museum specimens remain crucial for advancing our understanding through innovative methods.

Putin, Xi and a bigger Brics: India becomes the stage for high-stakes global diplomacy test
stories.summary: New Delhi hosts the significant BRICS Summit, bringing together powerful global leaders. The expanded bloc now represents nearly half the world's population. India prioritizes practical cooperation in areas like food and energy security. The summit faces challenges from global disruptions and geopolitical rivalries. Leaders aim to achieve meaningful outcomes and strengthen collective influence.

stories.title: Scotland’s first wind farm recycled 99.9% of 26 turbines, blades became polymers
Steven Spielberg bought an LA horse ranch for $5.75M; 27 years later, he is selling it for $29.9M
stories.summary: Steven Spielberg and his wife are selling their stunning Los Angeles ranch for $29.9 million, a significant increase from the $5.75 million they invested in 1999. This gorgeous property features premium equestrian facilities and lavish living quarters. Earlier dreams of a five-story riding stable were scrapped, but the ranch has been a vital component of their real estate holdings for almost three decades.

stories.title: South China Sea methane leak formed a 1km plume; worms and bacteria built a ‘worm bed’ in 2 years
stories.summary: A South China Sea drilling incident caused a significant methane leak in 2018. Ocean scientists observed an ecosystem rapidly responding to the underwater gas release. Bacteria and worms quickly formed a methane-munching 'worm bed' within two years. This new biofilter degraded methane effectively, reducing plume height significantly. However, this rapid ecosystem development caused a notable decrease in original microbial diversity.

stories.title: Man lost his ring in 1973; 53 years later, fate brings it back
stories.summary: In 1973, a Kansas student misplaced his class ring during an epic snowball fight. Fast forward fifty-three years later, campus workers discovered the ring while tending to the grounds. Interestingly, the owner and his wife were driving through the city that same day, having just discussed the ring a week earlier. Now, the couple will restore and treasure the sentimental piece.

stories.title: Miami flight overrun: Plane touched down at nearly 300 kmph despite high-speed warning
stories.summary: A 21 Air Boeing 767 touched down at Miami International Airport at an alarming speed of nearly 300 kmph. As the crew attempted to execute a go-around following the landing, they had neglected to deploy the speed brakes, leading to automated alerts about the steep descent and proximity to the ground. Investigators are now analyzing the flight data and cockpit voice recordings to uncover further insights regarding this incident.

stories.title: $250M crypto fraud allegedly funded six homes, Lamborghinis and dozens of Louis Vuitton bags
stories.summary: Christopher Alexander Delgado admitted to a $250 million crypto fraud scheme. His company, Goliath Ventures, promised investor returns from liquidity pools. Instead, funds paid earlier investors and funded a lavish personal lifestyle. Delgado purchased numerous luxury properties, vehicles, and designer accessories. He now faces significant prison time and asset forfeiture for his actions.

stories.title: After 9/11, Gander sheltered 7,000 Americans as 38 planes landed after attack
In 1982, Israel released 28 wild donkeys; 44 years later, they created a desert oasis
stories.summary: In an effort to rejuvenate the parched landscape of Israel's Ramon Crater, wild donkeys were brought back into the ecosystem. These resilient animals played a crucial role by creating waterholes, which became essential for desert wildlife. Additionally, their droppings helped spread acacia seeds, promoting the growth of trees. Their natural movements resulted in water-retaining depressions, significantly transforming the area's ecology into a thriving environment that has caught global attention.

JD Vance defends Usha's heritage, hits out at Michigan Senate candidate El-Syed
'Plotting a super-tainted majority': Congress taunts Centre over delay in Parliament prorogation
Texas Czech festival marks 50 years as couples return with children, grandchildren
Dam Removal Restores Creek: Buckhorn Creek flows freely again; volunteers plant trees
stories.summary: After more than a century, the Buckhorn Creek dam has been dismantled, reviving its original flow for the first time in 125 years. A modern ninety-foot bridge now crosses the creek, enhancing access for trail enthusiasts. This ecological restoration significantly improves aquatic habitats, particularly supporting brook trout populations. Additionally, volunteers will introduce native plants along the banks to help stabilize the soil.

stories.title: 'Prioritise national interest': Shashi Tharoor advises govt to keep Brics 'non-West'
stories.summary: As Brics chair in 2026, India will host the 18th Brics summit in New Delhi on September 12 and 13. The summit will bring together leaders of Brics member and partner countries, as well as outreach invitees. Leaders are expected to discuss ways to strengthen intra-Brics cooperation on common priorities and exchange views on global and regional issues of mutual importance, according to a statement issued by the MEA.

stories.title: Yogi Adityanath pays tribute to UP's first CM Govind Ballabh Pant on his 139th birth anniversary
stories.summary: "On this occasion, on behalf of the Government of Uttar Pradesh and the revered people of Uttar Pradesh, I pay homage to the memories of Pandit Govind Ballabh Pant ji on the occasion of his auspicious birth anniversary, and offer my humble tributes," Yogi said.

stories.title: "Legacy of our ancestors...": CM Pushkar Singh Dhami hails Rudrapur's transformative growth at Punjabi Gaurav Sammelan
stories.summary: Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami on Thursday lauded the pioneering legacy and transformative contributions of the ancestors and various communities in turning Rudrapur into a vibrant industrial hub and the granary of the nation.

Satya Niketan puts safety, housing at heart of DUSU battle
ED raids Ramnandi Hotels in alleged Rs 132-crore bank fraud case; 9 locations searched
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate searched nine locations across three states in an alleged bank fraud case. Ramnandi Hotels and Resorts Ltd is accused of diverting Rs 58 crore from bank loans. The company allegedly used fake reports and personal guarantees to secure these funds. Five pledged properties were reportedly sold at undervalued prices recently. The agency suspects these actions aimed to prevent asset attachment and recover crime proceeds.

Brics summit: What’s on agenda as world leaders gather in Delhi amid global tensions
‘Shared aspiration for global well-being': PM Modi's message ahead of Brics summit
xQc Explains NoPixel Absences: Co-owner says some GTA RP stars self-excluded; others moved on
stories.summary: xQc has addressed the absence of several major GTA RP streamers from NoPixel 5.0, including Summit1G and Chang Gang members. The NoPixel co-owner said some players chose to leave the server and build their own community, while others had previously criticized NoPixel. xQc argued that Summit could return if he wanted, but claimed he is staying away because his friends were not invited. NoPixel 5.0 launched on September 8.

India's investment in innovation low, we need to develop our own engine for combat aircraft: Ex-DRDO head Saraswat
After countless hours searching for rare seahorses in French Polynesia, a photographer captured...
stories.summary: French photographer Julien Anton won the top prize at the Ocean Photographer of the Year 2026 awards. His winning image captured a male seahorse with two newborn juveniles in French Polynesia. Anton spent many hours searching for the rare seahorse family in Mo'orea. The photograph also won the Wildlife category before receiving the grand prize. Other international photographers also received awards across various competition categories.

Mr Singh is not any Sikh truck driver but Harjinder Singh, DHS says as it removes controversial post; Hasbro objects use of its characters
SC asks Centre to reduce cut-off to prevent super-specialty med seats going waste
Teen Uses Cancer Game: Daniel Zhang turns Tumor Tactics into learning tool; reaches 1,500 K-8 students
stories.summary: In an innovative step, a San Diego teenager named Daniel Zhang crafted Tumor Tactics, an educational game designed to demystify cancer for young minds. Motivated by his grandmother's battle with the illness, Daniel aims to make intricate cancer biology accessible to children. His project has garnered funding and will be showcased at the United Nations Science Summit, alongside his role in STEAMLabs International, where he promotes STEM and arts education.

Houthis seize Yemen's strategic Red Sea port city of Mokha from Saudi-backed forces
Wisconsin’s Apostle Islands Could Become a National Park Under New Proposal
San Francisco’s Candlestick Point breaks ground; $130M phase to pave way for 7,200 homes across 270 acres
stories.summary: San Francisco’s long-delayed Candlestick Point redevelopment is finally moving forward nearly a decade after Candlestick Park was demolished. The $130 million first phase will fund roads, utilities and other infrastructure across the 270-acre site, paving the way for a massive mixed-use neighborhood featuring up to 7,200 homes, retail, offices, parks and community spaces.

‘Respect Thailand’s laws’: Protesters rally outside Israel embassy in Bangkok
Princess Diana’s 'revenge dress' up for auction at Rs 2.8 crore
Philadelphia gave 340 seniors white roofs; homes cooled by 5°F, saving 560 kWh
"I gotta be the first": IShowSpeed makes history with iPhone Duo stunt at Apple event
stories.summary: During Apple's highly anticipated product launch event, streamer IShowSpeed shocked the audience by executing a daring backflip while clutching the new iPhone Duo. This groundbreaking stunt made him the very first person to try such a feat with the foldable smartphone. Miraculously, he nailed the move and kept the expensive device safe, leading to a viral sensation that captured the tech community's imagination.

stories.title: Scientists transform coffee waste into a material that makes concrete stronger by 29%
stories.summary: Researchers transformed used coffee grounds into a valuable construction material. Pyrolysis converted the grounds into biochar, which improved concrete's compressive strength. Replacing fifteen percent of sand with biochar increased concrete strength by nearly thirty percent. This process reduces waste and the need for natural construction resources. Further laboratory testing is needed before widespread commercial application.

stories.title: Volunteers removed 100,000 sea urchins in Norway; kelp and fish nurseries return
stories.summary: Nearly 100,000 sea urchins have been removed from three northern Norway sites by almost 500 volunteers since 2024. The effort has helped kelp and seaweeds return to previously barren seabeds, creating nursery habitat for fish and supporting marine biodiversity. Continued monitoring aims to ensure the underwater forests can recover and persist.

13-year-old Massachusetts inventor Kaia Minn turned orange peels into seed pods
